name: 97838 · Hermiston, OR
findings: ZIP 97838 (Hermiston) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97838 (Hermiston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
